Team — attached is a short commercial summary and recommended quote. Key points below:

- Proposed concession: 25% off Hosted API token rates for first 6 months (pilot period)
- Minimum commitment: 12-month SOW with 6-month ramp period; first 6 months reimbursed at discounted rate, months 7-12 revert to standard rates with a 10% uplift if volumes exceed initial commit
- Onboarding: include one week of remote Professional Services (2 engineers) at $8k one-time fee
- Condition: Redwood reserves the right to re-evaluate discount if observed token utilization or latency/SLA requirements materially exceed assumptions

From a win/loss standpoint, 25% buys us a realistic chance to close the pilot while limiting long-term revenue erosion. If we want to go to 28%, we will need an exec-sanctioned exception (Rishi or CFO OK).

I've added language that requires a DocuSign signature and ties the concession to the SOW. Please review and let me know if I should escalate.

Best,

- At 25% discount, unit contribution remains modest but acceptable for a strategic pilot (expected contribution margin ~28% after PS revenue)
- At 28% discount the expected margin falls below team threshold for new logos in regulated verticals (~16% margin) — exposure acceptable only with exec approval and a curtailed SOW or higher onboarding fee
- Recommendation: approve up to 25% from Deal Desk. For >25% require exec OK with clear expiration (6 months) and a commit to a minimum monthly invoiced floor (we propose $2,500/mo)

I've attached the cost sheet and redlines to the SOW.

Rishi — sorry to pull you in on short notice. ClearRiver has asked for a 28% concession for the first 6 months; Deal Desk recommends 25% as the ceiling without exec sign-off.

Why we should consider an exception:
- Strategic healthcare partner with multi-product expansion potential; positive reference value in the payer/provider segment
- Pilot is timeboxed (6 months discounted), full SOW is 12 months with renewal at standard rates
- We can protect unit economics with a minimum monthly floor and include PS for faster time-to-value

Risks / guardrails I propose if you approve >25%:
- Cap concession duration to first 6 months only
- Require DocuSign SOW with minimum monthly invoice floor of $2,500 and stated ramp milestones
- Add SLA clause that preserves Redwood's right to revert pricing if token usage materially exceeds projections
- Require aligned Legal signoff (I attached redlines)

Requested approvals:
- Approve up to 28% for the first 6 months conditional on the guardrails above OR
- Approve 25% (Deal Desk recommended ceiling) so we can commit before ClearRiver's Thursday deadline
